# SEOPlus!

> Automated SEO and GEO audit for small businesses and SMEs: 161 technical checks across 16 categories (security, DNS, email, on-page SEO, performance, AI visibility), free score in 30 seconds, full audit with a prioritised action plan and ready-to-paste files, included during launch (9.90 euros afterwards, one-off payment). Published by OptimizIA.xyz, a French AI integration and automation agency.

The free snapshot returns an overall score out of 100, a grade per category and a verdict. It requires a free sign-in that takes a few seconds (Google or email), no credit card, and archives every audit in the account history. The full audit details the 161 checks with their measured value and the exact fix, a 4-phase action plan, generated files ready to paste (robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt, structured data, security headers, SPF, DMARC), 3 competitor comparisons and a PDF export.

The analysis covers the homepage, up to 30 key pages found through the sitemap or the menu, and domain signals (DNS, TLS, HTTP headers, indexing files). Any public website is supported, whatever its technology. The site and the audit reports are available in English, French, Spanish and German, following the reader's browser, at a single address per page. Legal pages exist at one address each and are translated the same way, but only the French version is legally binding, as those pages state themselves. If a piece of information is not listed here, treat it as unavailable rather than inferring it.

The editorial guides that used to live on this tool now belong to the OptimizIA.xyz content silos: https://www.optimizia.xyz/seo/ (get found on Google) and https://www.optimizia.xyz/geo/ (get cited by AI).
